VIRO-0143.title: Consume TextFrameProperties: insets, vertical align, auto-size in the type engine
VIRO-0143.outcome: Text frames honor their validated textFrame contract: insets shrink the measure, verticalAlign positions the composed block, autoSize grows the frame to fit content, and single-column zero-inset frames render pixel-identically to today.

VIRO-0144.title: Caret/selection fidelity from HarfBuzz clusters + inert script/direction fields
VIRO-0144.outcome: Caret stops derive from HarfBuzz cluster boundaries so carets and selection highlights land correctly under kerning and ligatures; story script/direction/language feed HarfBuzz instead of guessSegmentProperties; per-line compose stops re-shaping every prefix.
